newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Inland Resources started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Inland Resources started.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Thursday it initiated coverage of Inland Resources Inc with a buy rating and a price target of $16.

-- Inland Resources is an exploration and production company that has focused its operations exclusively on the Monument Butte Field in northeastern Utah, Rodman said. It has a competitive operating advantage because of its focus on a single field and its excellent cost structure, Rodman said.
-- Rodman added Inland Resources is highly undervalued because the true reserve potential has not been fully valued by investors and little research coverage is available.
-- Inland shares were trading up 1/2 Thursday at 9-1/4.
